intro.text: The Vavibrar is a Rosharan literary work. A passage it quotes from an older text appears in an epigraph about Urithiru.

description.text: The passage says some of Urithiru's founders hoped to build it in Alethela, one of the Silver Kingdoms, but that this could not be done.
Jasnah thought its source the oldest surviving original text to mention Urithiru, and wished she could read the dead language Dawnchant.
